method.cold: New isolated browser context, HTTP cache disabled, service workers blocked and bypassed
method.ready: First animation frame with inspect3d.ready, requested model ID, more than the floor-only frame (1 draw call / 2 triangles), and no visible loading/error overlay
method.byteMetric: CDP Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength; HTTP transfer bytes, including protocol headers as reported by Chromium
method.resourceTiming: Browser transferSize / encodedBodySize / decodedBodySize are recorded separately
method.geometry: The selected production GLB is loaded in full. This harness performs no LOD substitution, geometry edits, or visibility changes.

limitations: Two runs per model describe this host and browser; they do not establish a speed SLA or a pass/fail performance threshold.
CDP network emulation is 4 Mbps down / 1 Mbps up with 80 ms latency. CPU and GPU are not throttled; this is not a mobile-device simulation.
Client HTTP caches are disabled. DNS, server/OS caches and server load are not reset.
Draw-call counts describe the rendered frame at readiness, not a measured frame rate.
Other agents ran 48-model and UI browser checks concurrently on this host. Ready times include possible contention and are not a GPU performance reference.
